scenario_review.clear_recording: package the actual operation; do not replace it with a built interface
scenario_review.stable_state_reading: use a clear screenshot when a prompt or setting needs reading; do not simulate typing merely for decoration
scenario_review.poor_or_unstable_crop: first revise the edit or choose a clear source frame; quality alone does not trigger UI reconstruction
scenario_review.long_typing: a concise built input demo may explain this core interaction; preserve verified input and return to real feedback
scenario_review.contextual_overlay: use the same operation stage as a blurred or dimmed recording background; keep scene identity and preserve critical actions
scenario_review.unknown_labels_or_results: verify or omit uncertain details; no fabricated product states or improved outcomes
scenario_review.whole_video: real operation and real results remain the main line; no fixed footage ratio is imposed
scenario_review.static_slide_deck: reject repeated page swaps or title/static-image/fade sequences as packaging motion
scenario_review.camera_only_motion: reject for card motion if the material has no independent spatial or structural action
scenario_review.video_only_motion: source video playback does not prove authored camera or material motion
scenario_review.screenshot_highlighting: require accurate target binding, visible attention progression and a readable landing; a static frame alone is insufficient
scenario_review.meaningful_holds: allow stable reading and full real-result observation; do not add pointless movement to meet a checklist
scenario_review.missing_visual_evidence: mark unverified and review actual playback/intermediate frames before declaring the motion passed
scenario_review.already_clipped_source: reject half logos/navigation even if the outer card is complete; select an intact source or omit an entire irrelevant damaged region at a clean boundary
scenario_review.missing_required_evidence: do not synthesize missing product details; record the gap and only request replacement when the evidence is essential and irreplaceable
scenario_review.mid_motion_clipping: inspect source-mapped target corners, nested masks and occlusion through acceleration, overshoot and maximum perspective, not only endpoints or centers
scenario_review.intentional_closeup: allow a focused view with complete target/context and clean crop boundaries; preserve authentic scroll viewport behavior
scenario_review.caption_cleanup_mask: do not cover menus, inputs or buttons while hiding original captions
scenario_review.glow_bounds: allow soft decorative spill but reject visible hard rectangular blur edges; keep blur off world/camera and readable content
scenario_review.black_background_composite: reject an overall dark-green/teal cast even when the CSS base is black; inspect the final composite
scenario_review.static_gradient: a solid fill or static gradient does not meet the moving-glow requirement; author a separate slow deterministic track
scenario_review.explicit_user_color: respect explicit alternate colors; init must not overwrite an existing plan
scenario_review.three_d_preserved: repair source selection, framing, masks and camera trajectory without flattening all motion or replacing the real-operation main line
scenario_review.aabb_anchor: For a tilted rectangular target, elementAnchor* AABB center/corners can drift; use true plane-coordinate projection or separate zero-size DOM marker points.
scenario_review.visible_flag: Depth or layout eligibility does not imply containment or unobstructed visibility; separately review all corners, masks and occlusion over the full trajectory.
